preconditions.description: Each string in the input list must be composed of exactly two words.
The input list can be empty or contain one or more reindeer names.

postconditions.description: The output list must be sorted by the last names of the reindeer.

postconditions.expression: all(name in stdout for name in reindeer_names)
postconditions.description: All input reindeer names must be present in the output list.
